info.name: Team 19 – Deployed security regression (live site)
info.description:
Hana Fady, issue #12. Security regression tests against the DEPLOYED API and website (https://team19-api.vercel.app, https://team19-web.vercel.app). Safe for production: it creates, changes and deletes nothing (the only write is one failed login for a made-up @example.test email, which is audited like any failed login).

Runs automatically in GitHub Actions after every deploy and once a day (.github/workflows/deployed-regression.yml). Folder 6 (roles) runs only when the low-privilege test accounts staffEmail/staffPassword and customerEmail/customerPassword are given as repository secrets; no Admin credentials are ever used.

item.name: 1. Deployed API is up, with security headers

exec: pm.test('CSP: loads nothing, cannot be framed', () => { const c = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Security-Policy') || ''; pm.expect(c).to.include("default-src 'none'"); pm.expect(c).to.include("frame-ancestors 'none'"); });

item.name: Unknown route -> 404 JSON, headers still set

exec: pm.test('no internal details', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ['SyntaxError', 'at ', 'node_modules', 'stack', 'pg_'].forEach((s) => pm.expect(t).to.not.include(s)); });
pm.test('no internal details', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ['SyntaxError', 'at ', 'node_modules', 'stack', 'pg_'].forEach((s) => pm.expect(t).to.not.include(s)); });
pm.test('no internal details', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ['SyntaxError', 'at ', 'node_modules', 'stack', 'pg_'].forEach((s) => pm.expect(t).to.not.include(s)); });

item.name: 2. CORS: only our website may call the API from a browser
Another site's origin is not allowed
Preflight from another site gets no permission
3. Every protected route refuses a request without a token
4. Forged and malformed tokens are refused

exec: pm.test("message: Invalid or expired token", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Invalid or expired token"));

item.name: 'alg: none' token claiming to be user 1 -> refused

exec: pm.variables.set('forgedNone', b64({ alg: 'none', typ: 'JWT' }) + '.' + b64({ sub: '1', role: 'Admin', iat: now, exp: now + 3600 }) + '.');
pm.test('refused (401 from the API, or 403 from the Vercel firewall)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401, 403]));

item.name: HS256 token signed with a guessed secret -> 401

exec: pm.variables.set('forgedHs', b64({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' }) + '.' + b64({ sub: '1', role: 'Admin', iat: now, exp: now + 3600 }) + '.' + 'c2lnbmF0dXJlLWZyb20tYS1ndWVzc2VkLXNlY3JldA');
pm.test("message: Invalid or expired token", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Invalid or expired token"));
pm.variables.set('expired', b64({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' }) + '.' + b64({ sub: '1', iat: 1600000000, exp: 1600003600 }) + '.c2ln');
pm.test("message: Invalid or expired token", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Invalid or expired token"));

item.name: Token in the URL instead of the header -> 401
5. Login does not reveal which accounts exist

exec: pm.test("message: Invalid email or password", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Invalid email or password"));
pm.test('no internal details', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ['SyntaxError', 'at ', 'node_modules', 'stack', 'pg_'].forEach((s) => pm.expect(t).to.not.include(s)); });
pm.test('no internal details', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ['SyntaxError', 'at ', 'node_modules', 'stack', 'pg_'].forEach((s) => pm.expect(t).to.not.include(s)); });

item.name: 6. Roles on the live site (runs only when test accounts are given)

exec: pm.test('no password hash in the response', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('password_hash'));

item.name: Staff cannot read the audit log -> 403
Customer probing a plan that isn't theirs -> 404
Customer sees only their own plans

exec: pm.test('no internal tasks or notes in the list', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t).to.not.include('"visibility":"internal"'); });

pm.test('CSP: only our own scripts, no framing', () => { const c = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Security-Policy') || ''; pm.expect(c).to.include("script-src 'self'"); pm.expect(c).to.include("frame-ancestors 'none'"); pm.expect(c).to.include("object-src 'none'"); });
pm.test('CSP: may only call our API', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Security-Policy') || '').to.include('https://team19-api.vercel.app'));
